title: Into the River of Secrets/Quotes
summary:
"I work for the Foundation. Sure I know about Titans but to actually see one?"
- Peter to Sophie Casterwill

"Miss Attitude spooks me!"
- Peter to Sophie Casterwill, about Zhalia Moon

"When the Foundation approached me, I realised their ideals were exactly what I was looking for. To protect history and not exploit it, to learn without limits, to explore ancient secrets and preserve forgotten traditions."
- Peter to Lok Lambert, about how he joined the Huntik Foundation

"You're outnumbered Dante Vale, give up before someone really gets hurt." (Grier)

"There more of you, but none more mighty then Metagolem." (Dante Vale, right before invoking Metagolem)
